doc.name: BumbleBox
doc.instructions: BumbleBox is an email client with AI triage over all of the user's connected mailboxes. Emails are identified by the id returned by search_emails and list_to_answer. BumbleBox sends nothing without the user's click, or a standing permission the user set in BumbleBox for a precise scope (replies to the existing sender of a thread, with no commitment), capped, logged and cancellable: send_reply follows that setting and reports what it did; draft_reply only prepares a draft. Campaign drafts are written inside their campaign and sent only from BumbleBox. trash_email moves certified noise, and filed notifications, to the trash and proposes anything else to the user; clean_filed_mail does it for all the filed mail of one sender; nothing is ever deleted permanently, and archived, moved or trashed emails can be put back with restore_to_inbox.

tools.name: search_emails
tools.title: Search emails
tools.description: Searches every connected mailbox (sender, subject, preview), newest first. Operators: from:, subject:, before:YYYY-MM-DD, after:YYYY-MM-DD, in:sent (only what the user sent, from any mailbox or alias); the rest is free text. Deleted emails are not returned.

tools.name: get_email
tools.title: Read an email
tools.description: One email in full: sender, recipients, date, subject, plain-text body, attachment names, folder and BumbleBox classification.

id.description: Email id, as returned by search_emails or list_to_answer.

tools.name: list_to_answer
tools.title: Emails waiting for a reply
tools.description: Received emails BumbleBox classified as needing a reply and still in the inbox, newest first.

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts
tools.description: Contacts BumbleBox knows from the mail history (name, address, organization domain, exchange counts, last exchanges, VIP mark, note), matched on name, address or domain.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.title: List mail folders
tools.description: The folders of each connected mailbox, as last synced. Trash, spam, sent and drafts are left out.

tools.name: list_calendar_events
tools.title: List calendar events
tools.description: Events of the connected Google calendars between two dates (default: the next 7 days, at most 62 days).

tools.name: draft_reply
tools.title: Prepare a reply (not sent)
tools.description: Saves the text as the reply draft of a received email, from the address the email was written to (a brand address or the mailbox). needsIdentity: that address cannot send until the user verifies it in BumbleBox. Nothing is sent: the draft waits in BumbleBox (Pilotage › prepared replies) until the user reviews it and clicks Send. Saving again replaces the previous draft of the same email.

email_id.description: Email id, as returned by search_emails or list_to_answer.

tools.name: send_reply
tools.title: Reply to the sender
tools.description: Replies to the sender of one received email, and only to them (no Cc, no Bcc, no attachment), from the address the email was written to. What happens next is the level the user set in BumbleBox for this kind of reply: a draft, a reply waiting for one tap (the default), or a reply that leaves after a delay the user can cancel. Anything that commits the user (amounts, bank details, acceptance, contracts, dates, links) always waits for the user, and so does a reply from an address the user has not verified (needsIdentity). The result says which one applied.

email_id.description: Email id, as returned by search_emails or list_to_answer.

tools.name: archive_email
tools.title: Archive an email
tools.description: Moves one inbox email to its mailbox's archive folder, on the mail server too. Undone by restore_to_inbox. Nothing is deleted.

email_id.description: Email id, as returned by search_emails or list_to_answer.

tools.name: move_email
tools.title: Move an email to a folder
tools.description: Moves one inbox email to an existing folder of the same mailbox (see list_folders), on the mail server too. No folder is created. Undone by restore_to_inbox.

email_id.description: Email id, as returned by search_emails or list_to_answer.

annotations.title: Move an email to a folder

tools.name: trash_email
tools.title: Put an email in the trash
tools.description: Moves one email to its mailbox's trash. In the inbox: only when BumbleBox certifies it as noise (spam, newsletter, promotion, unanimous safety vote, no known contact or action word). Already filed out of the inbox (Notifications, Newsletters, archive…): when it is noise, a notification or an automated alert, with no known contact or action word. Any other email is not moved: it becomes a proposal the user confirms in one tap in BumbleBox. Never a permanent deletion; undone by restore_to_inbox.

email_id.description: Email id, as returned by search_emails or list_to_answer.

reason.description: Why, shown to the user with a proposal.

annotations.title: Put an email in the trash

tools.name: clean_filed_mail
tools.title: Clean the filed mail of one sender
tools.description: Moves to the trash every email of one sender (an address, or @domain for a whole domain) that is already filed out of the inbox, in every connected mailbox, when it is noise, a notification or an automated alert. Because the sender is named, action words and known-contact status do not keep a mail; a protected category (a real conversation, a transaction, a legal notice) or a mail the user reclassified by hand still stays. The inbox is never touched, nor a mail the server still shows in the inbox. Returns how many were trashed, which were kept and why, how many are still in the inbox and how many were not found on the server. Never a permanent deletion; each email is undone by restore_to_inbox.

sender.description: An email address, or @domain.com for every address of that domain.

folder.description: Only the mail filed in this folder (see list_folders).

annotations.title: Clean the filed mail of one sender

tools.name: restore_to_inbox
tools.title: Put an email back in the inbox
tools.description: Moves an archived, filed or trashed email back to the inbox, on the mail server too.

email_id.description: Email id, as returned by search_emails or list_to_answer.

annotations.title: Put an email back in the inbox

tools.name: list_missions
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: The user's prospection campaigns (missions), most recently active first, with the number of drafts waiting, emails sent and prospects who replied.

tools.name: list_campaign_drafts
tools.title: List the drafts of a campaign
tools.description: The drafts of one campaign that wait for the user to validate them in BumbleBox (recipient, subject, plain-text body, sender), newest first, with the true totals.

mission_id.description: Campaign id, as returned by list_missions.

annotations.title: List the drafts of a campaign

tools.name: list_replies_to_validate
tools.title: Campaign replies waiting for the user
tools.description: Replies received on campaigns that still need the user: prepared reply drafts waiting for validation, and replies with no answer yet (with the stored AI triage: kind, summary, whether a human is needed).

annotations.title: Campaign replies waiting for the user

tools.name: create_campaign_draft
tools.title: Write a campaign draft (not sent)
tools.description: Writes one draft inside an existing campaign, to one recipient (added to the campaign list if new), from the campaign's sender. Nothing is sent: the draft waits for the user to validate the campaign send in BumbleBox.

mission_id.description: Campaign id, as returned by list_missions.

name.description: Recipient name, for a new prospect.

tools.name: update_campaign_draft
tools.title: Edit a campaign draft (not sent)
tools.description: Changes the subject, body or recipient of a draft that is still a draft. Nothing is sent, and a draft the user already validated cannot be changed.

mission_id.description: Campaign id, as returned by list_missions.
